defect: The fix only adds test cases (secret lookups by type) to this test file; the repaired lookup defect lives in the secret manager sources, not in this test.
reason: This change only added a test file and the fix's edits to it are test additions, so no defect lies in lines this change added.

defect: The fix relaxes the rows_consistent requirement when columns are set and ignore_errors is on, so a CSV with a too-wide row (null_padding + ignore_errors + columns) is still sniffed.
reason: The rows_consistent condition was not touched by this change, and before it the same input (a 3-column row with null_padding and ignore_errors, num_cols from the most frequent count) was also neither counted nor padded, so the failure predates the change.

defect: The fix makes the has-updates check also consider updates on the validity child column (HasUpdates override) and scans checkpoint segments accordingly.
reason: The updates check (updates ? true : false) predates this change, which only replaced Flatten with ToUnifiedFormat in Select, a line the fix only renames.

defect: The fix removes the use of EnumType::GetTypeName, which a later commit (7b82934, removing enum catalog links) deleted from the C++ API.
reason: GetTypeName existed when this change was made, so the build break came from a later API removal, not from this change.

defect: The fix computes CSV scan progress by summing per-file progress over all file scans instead of file_idx/total plus progress of the current file, and registers single-threaded file scans.
reason: The file_idx/total + progress formula was moved unchanged from the old ParallelCSVGlobalState::GetProgress in read_csv.cpp, and the multi-file file_scans structure the fix corrects did not exist in this change.

defect: The change declares template FillFunctionDescriptions here and calls it, relying on an implicit instantiation emitted in another translation unit (register_function_list.cpp), which recent gcc does not export, causing a link failure.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this bare template declaration with a static definition in this file (and makes the other one static), repairing the link failure introduced by these lines.

defect: The fix corrects the transient-row vector offset, which was one too large when the persistent row count is divisible by the vector size.
reason: The off-by-one expression (persistent max_row / STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE) + 1 was carried over unchanged from the old InitializeParallelScan, so it predates this change.

defect: sqlite3_step accumulates last_changes with += so sqlite3_changes returns the sum over all statements instead of the changes of the most recent statement.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line to an assignment, repairing a wrong result introduced by this change and visible against sqlite3_changes semantics.

defect: The fix stops ParallelCSVGlobalState::Next from writing the shared bind_data.options.file_path (a data race with threads copying the options) by keeping the current path in the global state.
reason: The racy assignment bind_data.options.file_path = bind_data.files[file_index++] already existed before this change, which only moved it into the !current_buffer branch.

defect: The fix changes ReadCSV::OpenCSV to take the file path and compression explicitly so the parallel reader no longer mutates shared options.file_path.
reason: The header declaration is an interface the fix redesigns; at this change OpenCSV was only called single-threaded during bind/init, and the race came with the later parallel multi-file Next code.

defect: The fix adds the interval.hpp include needed by Interval::GetMilli code added to data_chunk.cpp later, and rewrites types.size() > 0 as !types.empty() for clang-tidy.
reason: Interval was not used in data_chunk.cpp at this change, and the assert rewrite is a style change, so nothing this change added is repaired.

defect: IntervalConvert writes Interval::GetMilli (milliseconds) into a numpy array declared as timedelta64[ns], so intervals come out a million times too small.
reason: Both the GetMilli conversion and the timedelta64[ns] dtype were added in this change, and the fix replaces GetMilli with GetNanoseconds.

defect: The fix passes total_rows to the new RowGroupCollection in AddColumn/RemoveColumn/AlterType, appends altered row groups to result instead of a wiped this->row_groups, and sets current_row in InitializeAppend.
reason: The constructor calls already lacked total_rows and the AlterType loop over a freshly reset this->row_groups was unchanged context; this change only fixed the types passed, so these defects predate it.

defect: The fix makes CheckZonemap use the column's updates member instead of state.updates after the update-segment structure changed on master.
reason: This is an adaptation after merging with master (state.updates existed and was set in InitializeScan at this change), not a repair of a defect in the change.

defect: The fix updates the expected duckdb_indexes column count from 13 to 14 after another column was added.
reason: Both the change and the fix are test expectation updates following schema changes; no defect in code under test.

defect: The fix replaces the specialised aligned/unaligned/windowed-sum starts_with comparisons with a single length check plus memcmp.
reason: The original variants compute a correct prefix comparison, so the fix is a simplification made during review, not a defect repair.

defect: Switching the statement result to duckdb_result left release() calling duckdb_destroy_arrow on a duckdb_result pointer, get_schema leaking the logical types from duckdb_column_logical_type, and StatementRelease destroying an uninitialised result.
reason: The fix repairs exactly these lines (release uses duckdb_destroy_result, types are destroyed, the StatementRelease destroy is removed), all introduced by this change and visible from its diff (including the FIXME).

defect: duckdb_to_arrow_schema reinterprets the duckdb_logical_type array (an array of opaque handles) as an array of LogicalType objects, so real C API callers get garbage types or crash.
reason: The fix dereferences each handle instead of reinterpreting the array, repairing the broken C API interface added by this change; seeing it needs the handle typedef in duckdb.h.

defect: The fix replaces Key &k = *new Key(...) with make_unique so the temporary keys are no longer leaked.
reason: The leaking *new Key pattern was already in these lines before the change, which only added the key-length argument.

defect: Re-enabled templated_delete and templated_less_scan allocate keys with Key &key = *new Key(...) and never free them, leaking memory on every delete and range scan.
reason: These leaking lines were commented out before and became live in this change; the fix converts them (with the older insert/lookup ones) to make_unique.

defect: Cleanup asserts info->chunk and info->tuple_data for every DELETE/UPDATE entry, although entries whose prev is another undo entry have chunk == nullptr (handled a few lines below), so debug builds abort for tables without indexes.
reason: The fix moves exactly these added asserts inside the indexes check; the change newly applied them to UPDATE entries in Cleanup, and the contradiction with the following else-branch is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix changes size_t loop counters to int in the ART tests to avoid signed/unsigned comparison warnings.
reason: This is a test-only type tweak (the second loop predates the change), not a repair of a defect in code under test.

defect: The fix limits memory pre-faulting to block-sized allocations instead of every allocation whose size is not a multiple of 2 MiB.
reason: This is performance tuning; pre-faulting all allocations predates the change, which narrowed it, and no correctness defect is repaired.

defect: The fix reverts MAXIMUM_INITIAL_SINK_RADIX_BITS from 6 to 4 and lowers BLOCK_FILL_FACTOR to avoid minor performance regressions.
reason: A tuning constant change and its revert affect performance only, which is not a defect class here.

defect: The fix reformats the logging macros and adds DUCKDB_API to the inline CopyLoggerPtr helper.
reason: The header changes in the fix are formatting and an export annotation; no wrong behaviour in the lines this change added is evident.

defect: The fix processes converted UTF-8 bytes in forward order and buffers key_press instead of key_action.key_press in the Windows key reader.
reason: At this change remaining_presses was a stack popped from the back, so reverse pushing gave the right order; both defects came with the later BufferedKeyPresses refactor (6d6398d).

defect: IsTriviallyMappable returns true for leaf columns before checking the expected child position and type, so structs with reordered or retyped fields are treated as trivially mappable and skip remap_struct, giving wrong results.
reason: The fix removes exactly this early return added in the change, and the ordering mistake is visible in the new function.

defect: The fix clamps the occupancy-based aggregate cardinality estimate to the child cardinality (using exp) instead of asserting it.
reason: The estimate and its fallible assertion predate this change, which only loosened the assertion; the overestimation the fix addresses was already there.

defect: The fix sorts catalog_db_schemas in the test query so the expected output no longer depends on join order.
reason: Both the change and the fix only adjust test expectations; no defect in the code under test.

defect: The fix passes list_child_type by const reference instead of const value, for clang-tidy.
reason: Passing a LogicalType by const value is correct, so the fix is a style/performance tidy change.

defect: The fix makes ListLambdaBindData Copy and Equals tolerate a null lambda_expr.
reason: At this change lambda_expr was never null (Copy also dereferenced it); null bind data only appeared with later lambda serialization code.

defect: The fix replaces the Windows Logger::Info call with the DUCKDB_LOG_INFO macro after Logger::Info was removed.
reason: This change only renamed the log string in an existing Logger::Info call; the build break came from a later API removal.

defect: The BaseScanner constructor dereferences cur_buffer_handle->Ptr() before the null assert, and GetBuffer returns nullptr when the scan starts past the last buffer (e.g. a file exactly one buffer long), so it crashes.
reason: The fix guards exactly this dereference added in the change; the assert placed after the dereference shows the problem in the diff.

defect: GenerateStateMachineSearchSpace always uses DetectNewLineDelimiter, ignoring a user-specified new_line option that the removed SetNewLine respected (it only applied the detected value when NOT_SET).
reason: The fix restores use of the user-set new_line before falling back to detection, repairing a regression introduced by these lines and visible in the removed code.

defect: The fix initialises heap sizes and skips heap-pointer work for chunk parts whose heap is empty, avoiding a segfault.
reason: At this change a heap block was always allocated and heap sizes were read for every non-constant layout; the empty-heap path (total_heap_size != 0 check) was added later in 495d99e/b72952d.

defect: The fix removes the union_by_name block that pushed extra filename/hive-partition vectors into the output chunk.
reason: That block already existed before this change, which only rewrote its loop header, so the repaired behaviour predates it.

defect: The fix skips autoloading httpfs for encryption when the enable_mbedtls option is set.
reason: The enable_mbedtls option did not exist at this change (added later in 77369150), so the fix adapts to a later feature.

defect: The regenerated enum util adds ToChars/FromString for DictionaryAppendState as duckdb::DictionaryAppendState, but the enum lives in duckdb::dict_fsst, so DictionaryAppendState::REGULAR etc. do not compile.
reason: The fix removes exactly these generated entries (and blacklists the enum in the generator); the namespace mismatch is only visible in dict_fsst/common.hpp.

defect: SortKeyRecomputeHeapPointers sets each sort key's data to the new heap pointer itself, dropping the key's offset from the old heap pointer, so with per-block heap pointers all keys point to the block start.
reason: The fix adds the old-pointer diff to exactly this added function; the regular RecomputeHeapPointers in the same diff uses that diff, so the omission is visible.

defect: In vector.cpp the fix only inlines the tag_row_idx and member_row_idx locals in CheckUnionValidity, with identical semantics.
reason: The fix's change to this file is a behaviour-preserving refactor, so it repairs nothing in the lines this change added.
